<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Election Commission controversy:</strong> Opposition parties are demanding the ouster of Election Commissioners and a Supreme Court probe following reports of frequent internal disagreements and procedural disputes within the poll panel.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxOZTdoVmRLRGhuT0JQLTlQOGFXakZXV2RZeUlWZEt4aGdHbFhSaWhLR3ZyVXB4RXdFdW5NLTRGN1VRckRRSU9pbzRsUmhBdjVqMTlrUE9vSVRXYkZsdWhtZThXc1NKZ1lSeDVDeEhKZHBvcXBGZFdWdHRrNV80ZExmVExsNHNxdGhwbW52ZVRCMlNJZHFaLUNJYg?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I8</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I11</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Legislative failure:</strong> A Constitutional Amendment Bill aimed at providing women&#x27;s reservation in the Lok Sabha and State Assemblies has failed to pass in the lower house.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqwFBVV95cUxPSTVKRHVGUXlhNjVqNEczYkNpd1NvbmRYOU5Fd2RIZjV3OHBob0owSzh3LVRXdUVqSDNVZTgtbVZlUG8ybS1wallfSVdTeTRtNENIU0lwV3piczdxV2NEVmE0WC1GSTQyMjR4dkNPb1pqblB2SzNHQjZBRWVXZHpPZXE2bVlQc3NGNEFJVU1NUHJMMFFqSkdRUVFFMGZNRUkzSTc0LXphM1JaLXM?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I10</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Judicial review of appointments:</strong> The Supreme Court has referred a challenge against the current law governing the appointment of Election Commissioners to a larger bench for further constitutional scrutiny.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>BJP organizational changes:</strong> The ruling party has initiated a major reshuffle of its state party in-charges to strengthen its organizational structure.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
</ul>
